newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-OLYMPIC CHAMPION AUSTIN OUT OF HIGH JUMP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-OLYMPIC CHAMPION AUSTIN OUT OF HIGH JUMP FINAL.

text.p: Olympic champion Charles Austin was eliminated from the world championships high jump competition on Monday after failing to clear 2.28 metres.
The American, who won the Olympic title last year with a clearance of 2.39 metres, needed treatment to an injury during the qualifying round and could manage no better than 2.26 metres.
Briton Steve Smith, the Olympic bronze medallist who was not fully fit, was eliminated as well at the same height.
Former European champion Dragutin Topic of Yugoslavia was also eliminated minutes after Austin when he failed to clear 2.28 with his final attempt.
